welcome_message.name: Welcome Message
welcome_message.description: Auto-reply to first-time contacts with a greeting.
welcome_message.text: Hi! 👋 Thanks for reaching out. We'll get back to you shortly.

out_of_office.name: Out of Office
out_of_office.description: Auto-reply during off-hours so nobody is left waiting.
out_of_office.text: Thanks for your message! Our team is offline right now (9am–6pm) and will reply first thing tomorrow.

lead_qualifier.name: Lead Qualifier
lead_qualifier.description: Ask qualification questions to filter inbound leads.
lead_qualifier.text: Great — happy to help with pricing! Quick question: roughly how many seats are you looking for?

follow_up_reminder.name: Follow-up Reminder
follow_up_reminder.description: Send a nudge if a contact has not replied within 24 hours.
follow_up_reminder.text: Just circling back — did you have any other questions for us? Happy to help!

welcome_menu.name: Welcome menu
welcome_menu.description: Greet customers who type a keyword and route them to the right agent based on whether they're new or existing.
welcome_menu.text: Hi! 👋 Welcome to support. Are you an existing customer or new here?
welcome_menu.footer: Tap a button below to continue.
welcome_menu.existingNote: Existing customer needs assistance — please check account history before replying.
welcome_menu.newNote: New customer — share pricing + onboarding link.

faq_bot.name: FAQ bot
faq_bot.description: Answer common questions automatically. Customer picks a topic from a list; the bot replies with the answer and ends.
faq_bot.text: What can I help you with?
faq_bot.hoursAnswer: We're open Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm local time. Weekend support is limited to urgent issues.
faq_bot.pricingAnswer: Our pricing starts at $9/mo. Visit https://example.com/pricing for the full breakdown.
faq_bot.refundsAnswer: Refunds are honored within 30 days of purchase. Reply with your order number and we'll process it.
faq_bot.humanNote: Customer asked to talk to a human from the FAQ bot.

lead_capture.name: Lead capture
lead_capture.description: Greet first-time inbounds, capture name + email + company, then hand off to sales with the answers in the note.
lead_capture.intro: Welcome! 👋 I'll ask a few quick questions so we can get you to the right person.
lead_capture.askCompany: Almost done — what's your company name?
